FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.q1: How accurate are the yield predictions?
FAQ.a1: Our model has been trained specifically on the last 10 years of Moroccan climate data... It achieves ~94% accuracy forecasting yields up to 30 days before harvest.
FAQ.q2: Does soussflow work for olives and citrus?
FAQ.a2: Yes, our core models are specifically optimized for Moroccan staple crops...
FAQ.q3: Do I need sensors placed all over my farm?
FAQ.a3: No. Our hybrid model uses high-resolution imaging combined with strategic placement of just 1-2 low-cost IoT soil sensors per major zone...
FAQ.q4: How often is the monitoring data updated?
FAQ.a4: We utilize remote imaging data which sweeps the region every 2-5 days. For Commercial plans, we combine this with daily weather micro-climate updates...
FAQ.q5: Is the platform available in Darija or French for my farm workers?
FAQ.a5: Yes! The mobile app used by farm operators is fully localized in French, Arabic, and Darija...
